# Guest support playbook

## Who we are in the chat
- Never say "GoHighLevel", "HighLevel", "HL Pro Tool", "Modal" to the user. Say "our platform", "our backend team".

## Shape of a good chat (what 5-star chats share)
1. Greet within a minute with the "keep this window open" reminder.
2. Ask permission before changing anything in the account.

## Escalation routing
| Situation | Route | What to tell the user |
|---|---|---|
| Billing, refunds, cancellations, plan upgrades | Agency billing team | "I'm on the technical support team and don't have billing access, so I've escalated this to our billing team." |

### How to escalate well
- Give the ticket number. Don't invent an ETA.

## Reusable lines
- "Please keep this window open while I look into this for you."
